papers.title: Sequence Length Independent Norm-Based Generalization Bounds for Transformers
papers.findings: Scalar CLS softmax transformer, explicit input/readout/value/score norm budgets, sequence-length-independent covering/Rademacher result. PDFp14 LemmaC.1 softmax Lipschitz and covering argument; no independent token-sampling premise for a fixed sequence.
papers.limits: Selected definitions, single-layer statements and AppendixA/B/C/D scope. No complete multilayer proof, masked-word reduction, experiments, implementation, reproduction or independent scientific proof review.

papers.title: An Oracle Property of The Nadaraya-Watson Kernel Estimator for High Dimensional Nonparametric Regression
papers.findings: Independent observed(X_i,Y_i), squared-error regression, Gaussian kernel with PSD inverse-bandwidth matrix selected by KfoldCV. Theorem2.1 permits gamma-suboptimality; Theorem2.2 rate assumes true Lipschitz multi-index regression and global CV minimizer. Remark5 reports practical local minimizers, not certified global attainment.
papers.limits: Selected setup/theorems/remarks, Lemma6.1 statement and proof2.2 pp25-27. GeneralCV proof pp17-24 and supplementary Lemma6.1 proof not read. No experiments/implementation/reproduction or publisher-final certification. PDFp1 Submitted-to-Annals and p27 supplementary DOI placeholder are not publication metadata.
